decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution sits close to the firm's core aviation security know-how and has strong quantified evidence (UK Home Office use, over 30 government APIS connections), so the firm can readily interpret its results and keep improving it.

The cyber security awareness module draws on the firm's certified trainers and training infrastructure, so it costs little to maintain, but it still reports no results and sits further from the core physical-security knowledge base, which leaves a moderate risk of pruning.

The passenger profiling method builds directly on the firm's core aviation screening and operational expertise, giving it the absorptive capacity to learn from deployments and refine the method, even though evidence of results is limited.
